title: 172 A Street | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Private Pool And Large Outdoor Space- 172 A Street by Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: 172 A Street by Royal Destinations Location: Seacrest Beach Address: 172 A Street Details: Welcome to 172 A Street! Visitors looking for modern luxury right in the heart of 30A will fall in love with the beautiful layout, large pool, and private outdoor living area with plenty of space to entertain. This grand and spacious home with 3 stories and high ceilings takes full advantage of its private setting, which is only a four minute stroll to the beach. From the coastal decor and 7 smart tv's to the amazing outdoor spaces, this home is sure to impress. Simply relax and or take a dip in the private pool that overlooks the pristine wooded landscape surrounding Camp Creek Golf Course. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Parking Spaces: 4 in Driveway (Please Note: The garage is not for guest use.) -Dining Accommodations: Table Seating for 10, Bar Seating for 6 in screened in porch area. Indoor Dining Accommodations: Dining Table Seating for 8, Kitchen seating for 6. Outdoor Screened in Porch Dining Accommodations: Table seating for 10, Bar Seating for 6 -Coffee Maker Available -Private Pool: 20’ x 30’ *Pool heat is available for an additional $305 (pre-tax) *The pool heater does require 24 hours to reach the optimal temperature of 83-85 degrees. *Please contact Reservations to add this feature prior to your stay. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: 6 Bedrooms / 5.5 Baths / Sleeps 19 First Floor: -Bedroom 1 (En Suite): King Bed with Private Bath (Shower) and 50" TV -Kitchen / Dining Area (Dining Table Seating for 8, Kitchen nook seating for 6). / Living Room with 65" TV -Outdoor Screened-in living area, dining (Exterior screened porch Table seating for 10 plus bar seating for 6) and 65" TV. Outdoor -Laundry Room Second Floor: -Bedroom 2 (Grande Suite): King Bed and Queen pullout sofa with very large Private Bath (Soaking Tub and Shower) and 65" TV. Outdoor deck with table seating 6 -Bedroom 3: King Bed with Shared Bath (Shower and Soaking Tub) and 50" TV -Bedroom 4: King Bed with Shared Bath (Shower and Soaking Tub) and 50" TV Third Floor: -Game Room: Bunkroom and Game Room with 75" TV -Bedroom 5: (1) Twin/Twin Bunk Bed and (3) Twin Beds with Bath (Shower) (Total of 5 Twin Beds) Carriage House: -Bedroom 6: 2 Queen Beds, Private Shower and 50" TV Amenities Include: -6 Adult Bikes Please Note: *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. *The fireplaces are not operational. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
